name: Holy Hand Grenade
description: Conjures one Holy Hand Grenade. Right-click to pull its pin, release, then hold right-click to aim and release to throw. Bounces before settling, then explodes after an unpredictable 0-3 second delay. Movement restarts the wait. Deals 30 base physical damage at the center, falling off over 6 blocks, and can hurt its thrower. Does not damage terrain. Only one grenade per caster may exist, including stored, transferred and thrown grenades. Vanishes when its creator logs out. Requires a bound Conjuration core.
